evidence_claim_check.true: YES. In the snapshot (users.conroyri.nitrd_hackathon_v1_exporter_projects), 10213736 (FY2021, P30EY026877) has nih_spending_cats 'Bioengineering;Data Science;Eye Disease and Disorders of Vision;Networking and Information Technology R&D (NITRD);Neurosciences'. That includes the RCDC parent category (RePORTER id 329), stored by name. FY2021 is a build year, so this is not a reserved-year label read.
evidence_claim_check.grounded: AVAILABLE in a tool result, but the call is not confirmed for this run. outputs_get_project_detail returns spending_categories and is_nitrd (src/nih_grants_outputs/tools/get_project_detail.py; identical at the deployed 95e5dea and d7bad89). For 10213736 those would be the list above and is_nitrd true, so the claim is supported IF that tool was called with 10213736. The tool-call list for this /ask run was shown on the /ask page but was not captured. The only committed record of the same prompt (c224dd3f, eval/results/demo/20261109T004251Z_browser_approval_c224dd3f.json) called outputs_get_project_detail first, and flagged the same sentence as 'source not checked'. Checked in code: classifier_classify_parent takes an appl_id and returns suggestion, probability, cohort, top_features and model info, with no category field. portal_get_review_history returns sandbox requests only, and the sandbox held none at the time (0/0/0 after the row-10 cleanup). Its prior-year evidence (PriorYear.is_nitrd) is not confirmed to be in this run's result.
evidence_claim_check.what_the_gate_shows: Separately from the claim's truth: the Drafts page shows the draft's arguments only, and the /ask page shows tool names and arguments, not tool results. The approver cannot check from the approval UI whether a sentence in the evidence summary is grounded. The gate checks who authorises, not what is authorised.
